details.html:
1 of 5STUDIOS EARN AN A
FOR AI READINESS

Five studios compete for Fort Myers' dance students. Few have finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 5 dance and ballroom studios serving the Fort Myers market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 47 to 94. The AI engines name only four of the 5, and all one studios in Cape Coral were never named once. The field averages 60 (D) on AI readiness, 4 of 5 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 4 of 5 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 29 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Fort Myers, FL area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 5 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Dance Flow Fort Myers (94) and Arthur Murray Dance Studio Estero (81) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 47.
  • One of 5 earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 60 (D).
  • Of the 5 studios, 4 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 4 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. Only one has both.
  • Two of the 5 are franchise locations (one Arthur Murray and one Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • One site in the field still isn't served over HTTPS — a critical flag browsers show visitors before they see a single class schedule.
  • The gap between #1 and #5 is 47 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

One of the 5 studios is never named on any of the 6 checks: Rhythm In Motion. For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Fort Myers.” Every AI mention went to a studio inside the city. Studios that serve Fort Myers from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (5 studios): danceflowfortmyers.com, arthurmurrayestero.com, fredastaire.com/ft-myers, elegantrumba.com, capedance.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 29 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Fort Myers dance searches. Only five studios in these searches fit this field. Fred Astaire's Fort Myers Google listing has no website link; its page on fredastaire.com was used. Dance Flow Fort Myers has its own website and isn't connected to the Dance Flow studios on the Boca Raton page. Rhythm In Motion's site has no secure (https) address, so it was checked at its plain http address. Left out: Aki's Dance Studio and Secret of Dance Studio (no website of their own, though Google's AI Mode and ChatGPT name them), Ballroom by Josephine (no studio address on Google), Baila tu Ritmo (its website is gone), Suzanne's Dance Fitness (a fitness studio), and the youth, ballet and recital studios that lead the broad answers (The Dance Lounge, I.L.T. Dance Studio, G-Force Dance Company, Residance, Triple C Dance Academy, Gulfshore Ballet, Zero Gravity).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 29 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Fort Myers, FL?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Fort Myers, FL?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 29 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons fort myers fl”; “dance lessons fort myers fl”; “salsa lessons fort myers fl”; “wedding dance lessons fort myers fl”; “ballroom dance lessons cape coral fl”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in fort myers fl” and “ballroom dance studio fort myers”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
